model:
rachana: 1
sutra: news
version: 2
description: 
match: { kind: news, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "News · Headlines", id: "$.NEWS_ID" }
strip:
  - { label: "Entity", bind: "$.ENTITY" }
  - { label: "Edition", bind: "$.EDITION" }
  - { label: "Relevance filter", bind: "$.RELEVANCE_FILTER" }
  - { label: "Headlines", bind: "$.COUNT", fmt: "amount0", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Fetched", bind: "$.FETCHED_AT" }
panels:
  - id: headlines
    kind: table
    title: "Headlines, newest first"
    key: "F2"
    rows: "$.ITEMS"
    columns:
      - { label: "Published", bind: "@.PUBLISHED" }
      - { label: "Source", bind: "@.SOURCE" }
      - { label: "Headline", bind: "@.TITLE" }
      - { label: "Link", bind: "@.LINK" }
  - id: bySource
    kind: hbar
    title: "Headlines by source"
    key: "F3"
    area: right
    rows: "$.BY_SOURCE"
    label: "SOURCE"
    value: "COUNT"
    fmt: "amount0"
  - id: pipeline
    kind: table
    title: "How the headlines were chosen"
    key: "F4"
    area: right
    rows: "$.PIPELINE"
    columns:
      - { label: "Step", bind: "@.STEP" }
      - { label: "Kept", bind: "@.KEPT", fmt: "amount0" }
      - { label: "Dropped", bind: "@.DROPPED", fmt: "amount0" }
  - id: snapshot
    kind: markdown
    title: "Snapshot"
    area: right
    when: "nonblank($.SNAPSHOT)"
    text: "${$.SNAPSHOT}. Served offline from the demo lake (news-store), not live: the live connector is off or the server runs in offline mode (DRISHTI_OFFLINE=true)."
  - id: source
    kind: kv
    title: "Data source and terms"
    area: right
    rows: "$.PROVENANCE"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
keys: { F9: "raw" }
